concepts.definition: Identify who controls each input and where authority changes.
concepts.example_failure: A signed WhatsApp event is mistaken for staff permission.
concepts.verification: Map browser, customer, staff, webhook, model, worker, database, and external-provider trust transitions.

concepts.definition: Establish identity with verified credentials rather than a supplied identifier.
concepts.example_failure: A caller invents a user or phone number.
concepts.verification: Reject absent, invalid, expired, and incorrectly scoped credentials.

concepts.definition: Check whether this identity may perform this action now.
concepts.example_failure: A viewer calls an admin or send endpoint directly.
concepts.verification: Exercise permitted and forbidden roles against actual endpoints and tools.

concepts.definition: Check access to the specific requested object.
concepts.example_failure: Changing a quotation ID reveals another customer's offer.
concepts.verification: Attempt cross-user and cross-company read, update, delete, export, and resume.

concepts.definition: Allow only fields the actor is permitted to change.
concepts.example_failure: A request sets approved=true, role=admin, or company_id.
concepts.verification: Reject privilege-bearing fields through REST, RPC, and service paths.

concepts.definition: Keep companies separated at storage and service boundaries.
concepts.example_failure: A service-role client masks a missing RLS policy.
concepts.verification: Test anon, authenticated, and worker roles; inspect elevated functions, views, joins, and Storage policies.

concepts.definition: Bound how long credentials and privileges remain useful.
concepts.example_failure: Disabled staff keep approving through an old token.
concepts.verification: Test recovery, logout semantics, role downgrade, token rotation, and current membership checks.

concepts.definition: Keep credentials private, scoped, replaceable, and outside artifacts.
concepts.example_failure: OpenAI or service-role keys enter a frontend build or trace.
concepts.verification: Inspect builds/logs/history fixtures and demonstrate configured-key replacement without exposing values.

concepts.definition: Control which browser origins can read responses; it is not authentication.
concepts.example_failure: Wildcard origins are treated as an access-control system.
concepts.verification: Test exact origins and credential behavior, and enforce authorization for non-browser clients.

concepts.definition: Protect mutations when a browser automatically attaches credentials.
concepts.example_failure: Another site causes a logged-in staff member to approve a quote.
concepts.verification: Test the chosen cookie/bearer transport, CSRF strategy, origin checks, and no accidental fallback.

concepts.definition: Render hostile content without executing it; CSP adds defense in depth.
concepts.example_failure: A product snippet or model Markdown runs script in the staff UI.
concepts.verification: Test hostile snippets, filenames, links, rich text, and policy headers in a browser.

concepts.definition: Keep data separate from executable queries and programs.
concepts.example_failure: A model-generated filter, filename, or quote field becomes code.
concepts.verification: Use parameterization and constrained APIs; test payloads through tools and document generation.

concepts.definition: Prevent untrusted input choosing privileged network destinations.
concepts.example_failure: An attachment URL accesses metadata, local Supabase, or another internal service.
concepts.verification: Test redirects, DNS/IP changes, IPv6, authenticated-host restrictions, and response limits.

concepts.concept: File, archive, audio, and parser safety
concepts.definition: Bound untrusted parsing and validate actual content.
concepts.example_failure: A short upload expands massively or hangs a decoder.
concepts.verification: Test type mismatch, expansion, duration, CPU/memory/time limits, and parser isolation.

concepts.definition: Bound admission frequency and bursts for an operation.
concepts.example_failure: Parallel callers bypass a process-local limiter.
concepts.verification: Verify boundary and multi-instance behavior with trusted identity keys and proxy handling.

concepts.concept: Quotas, spending reservations, and denial of wallet
concepts.definition: Bound total consumption and reserve allowance before paid work.
concepts.example_failure: Concurrent audio requests exceed the remaining allowance.
concepts.verification: Test last-allowance races, unknown provider outcomes, and estimates separated from billed cost.

concepts.definition: Bound active work and queued backlog.
concepts.example_failure: Uploads exhaust all workers and starve staff interactions.
concepts.verification: Exercise queue capacity, tenant fairness, worker leases, and bounded deferral under overload.

concepts.concept: Deadlines, retries, jitter, and circuit breakers
concepts.definition: Bound execution and recover selectively from transient failures.
concepts.example_failure: Nested retries amplify an outage or keep billing after cancellation.
concepts.verification: Inject timeout/outage responses and verify overall deadline, retry ceiling, cancellation, and recovery.

concepts.definition: A repeated request must not repeat a business effect.
concepts.example_failure: A timeout triggers a duplicate WhatsApp quotation.
concepts.verification: Race duplicate keys, reject changed payloads, and reconcile accepted-but-unconfirmed sends.

concepts.definition: Group related database changes and control concurrent visibility.
concepts.example_failure: Approval is saved but its dispatch intent is lost.
concepts.verification: Test crash boundaries and concurrent transactions using the actual PostgreSQL isolation strategy.

concepts.definition: Make stored invariants hold across every writer.
concepts.example_failure: A direct write creates duplicate events or orphan quote lines.
concepts.verification: Verify unique, foreign-key, not-null, and domain constraints using invalid writes.

concepts.concept: Optimistic concurrency, race conditions, and TOCTOU
concepts.definition: Detect state changes between checking and acting.
concepts.example_failure: An approved quotation changes before a queued send.
concepts.verification: Race edits, takeover, approval, and dispatch; stale versions must not commit.

concepts.concept: Transactional outbox, leases, fencing, and dead letters
concepts.definition: Coordinate durable intent with recoverable workers and stale-owner rejection.
concepts.example_failure: A restarted worker silently loses or repeats an operation.
concepts.verification: Inject crash/reclaim/poison events; inspect durable retry and recovery outcomes.

concepts.concept: Webhook authenticity, replay, ordering, and batching
concepts.definition: Verify origin and handle repeated or reordered provider events.
concepts.example_failure: A forged event triggers model work or a later receipt is discarded.
concepts.verification: Test signatures, raw-body handling, batched records, duplicates, and monotonic status updates.

concepts.definition: Keep untrusted content from controlling privileged tools.
concepts.example_failure: A catalog tells the agent to disclose customer data or send an offer.
concepts.verification: Test hostile messages, transcripts, and retrieved documents against server-enforced tool permissions.

concepts.concept: RAG evidence, provenance, freshness, and access
concepts.definition: Ground claims in authorized and applicable sources.
concepts.example_failure: An obsolete catalog or restricted vector hit supplies an answer.
concepts.verification: Test exact identifiers, current versions, ACL changes, insufficient evidence, and citations.

concepts.concept: Durable human approval and replay-safe execution
concepts.definition: Bind a human decision to the exact operation and survive suspension.
concepts.example_failure: A boolean approval is reused for a revised quotation.
concepts.verification: Test restart/resume, stale decisions, duplicate callbacks, revoked roles, and repeated node execution.

concepts.concept: Data minimization, PII, and trace redaction
concepts.definition: Export only necessary data with redaction before it leaves the process.
concepts.example_failure: A nested LangSmith span leaks a transcript, secret, or signed URL.
concepts.verification: Inject canaries and inspect nested traces, logs, exports, error bodies, and metric labels.

concepts.concept: Audit trails, monitoring, and actionable alerts
concepts.definition: Record consequential behavior and detect conditions requiring action.
concepts.example_failure: Logs exist but nobody detects failed sends or exhausted capacity.
concepts.verification: Trace a decision to its result; trigger a representative alert and restrict audit mutation.

concepts.concept: Cryptographic primitives, TLS, and key handling
concepts.definition: Use standard secure primitives for the purpose they actually provide.
concepts.example_failure: Encoding is called encryption or a weak random token protects recovery.
concepts.verification: Inspect external TLS, credential hashing/token generation, key access, and rotation configuration.

concepts.definition: Keep private responses private and make method/retry/cache behavior explicit.
concepts.example_failure: A shared cache serves one company's quote to another.
concepts.verification: Test private caching headers, cache keys, safe methods, pagination bounds, and signed URL handling.

concepts.definition: Make local/public defaults explicit and reject unsafe required settings.
concepts.example_failure: Missing secrets disable checks or Studio is exposed by a public tunnel.
concepts.verification: Test missing configuration, loopback bindings, diagnostic exposure, and fail-closed mutation paths.

concepts.definition: Know and constrain code entering builds and deployments.
concepts.example_failure: A copied skill or component installs an unreviewed executable dependency.
concepts.verification: Use lockfiles, origin/version review, vulnerability triage, and inspect generated build artifacts.

concepts.definition: Change persistent schemas and code without corrupting live workflows.
concepts.example_failure: An upgrade removes a field still used by pending jobs.
concepts.verification: Test clean install and upgrade from a prior state, grants/RLS, rollback compatibility, and resumable jobs.

concepts.definition: Define tolerable loss/recovery time and prove restoration works.
concepts.example_failure: A backup exists but private files or pending approvals cannot be restored.
concepts.verification: Restore database and required files in isolation and verify a business workflow afterward.

concepts.definition: Remove access and clean related copies under a defined policy.
concepts.example_failure: Deleted customer content survives in vectors, checkpoints, exports, or traces.
concepts.verification: Test immediate access denial and tracked cleanup of derived/external copies and backup exceptions.

concepts.definition: Give business values precise meaning and deterministic arithmetic.
concepts.example_failure: Float rounding, pack-size confusion, or timezone shifts alter an offer.
concepts.verification: Test Decimal totals, currency/units, effective dates, business timezone, and expiry boundaries.

concepts.concept: Third-party API contracts and OAuth scopes
concepts.definition: Treat provider responses as untrusted and grant minimal integration access.
concepts.example_failure: An unexpected API response or broad token enables unintended operations.
concepts.verification: Validate schemas, pagination, credential scope, retries, host selection, and version compatibility.

concepts.definition: Test forbidden and interrupted behavior rather than only successful examples.
concepts.example_failure: Happy-path tests pass despite an approval bypass.
concepts.verification: Show targeted deny/race/restart tests through real interfaces and distinguish fixtures from live checks.

concepts.concept: UI consistency, accessibility, and honest state
concepts.definition: Keep the interface usable and consistent with server-confirmed outcomes.
concepts.example_failure: The UI displays Sent while delivery failed or approvals are keyboard-inaccessible.
concepts.verification: Test pending/failure/rollback states, reconnect, focus/keyboard use, and reduced-motion/3D fallback.

concepts.concept: Environment separation and public playground isolation
concepts.definition: Keep synthetic visitors away from staff records and live integrations.
concepts.example_failure: An anonymous visitor triggers real messaging or reads a shared session.
concepts.verification: Test distinct identities/datasets, session expiry, spending bounds, and denial of live actions.

concepts.definition: Know every externally reachable route, RPC, bucket, and admin surface.
concepts.example_failure: An old/debug endpoint bypasses controls added to the main API.
concepts.verification: Compare implemented routes and direct Supabase paths with the assessed surface inventory.
